visual_goal: Show the trust loop from policy through detection, decision, enforcement, statement and appeal, with appeals feeding outcomes back to decisions, detection and policy.
prompt: A circular loop diagram of six rounded boxes arranged clockwise around a ring, connected by bold blue arrows in order: top-left 'Trust policy' (small rule-book icon), top-right 'Detection' (small magnifying-glass icon), right 'Trust decision' (small gavel-free scale icon), bottom-right 'Enforcement' (small padlock icon), bottom-left 'Statement of reasons' (small letter icon), left 'Appeal' (small raised-hand icon). From 'Appeal', three thinner orange return arrows cross the inside of the ring: one into 'Trust decision' labeled 'overturned or upheld', one into 'Detection' labeled 'outcome labels', and one into 'Trust policy' labeled 'policy gaps'.
alt: A loop from trust policy to detection, trust decision, enforcement, statement of reasons and appeal, with appeal outcomes flowing back to decisions, detection and policy.

visual_goal: Show the trust platform: domain events become signals for detectors, gates request decisions, the decision service works with policy and cases, and the enforcement service pushes actions with receipts to consumers and statements to users.
prompt: A left-to-right architecture illustration on a light background. Far left, a box 'Domain events' with an arrow labeled 'signals' into a box 'Entity graph' drawn as small linked dots; one arrow from 'Entity graph' into a box 'Detectors'. One arrow from 'Detectors' into a central larger box 'Trust decision service'. Above the central box, a box 'Gates' drawn as a small row of turnstiles, with one arrow down into the central box labeled 'decision request'. Below-left of the central box, a box 'Policy registry' with one arrow into the central box. Directly below the central box, a box 'Case management' connected by a two-way arrow. From the central box one arrow right into a box 'Enforcement service'. From 'Enforcement service', one arrow right into a box 'Consumers' drawn as a stack of five small server blocks, labeled 'actions with receipts', and one arrow down into a box 'Statements of reasons' with a letter icon. A soft teal background panel groups the central box, 'Policy registry', 'Case management', 'Enforcement service' and 'Statements of reasons' as the shared platform.
alt: Domain events feed an entity graph and detectors; gates request decisions from the trust decision service, which uses a policy registry and case management and passes actions to the enforcement service, which sends them with receipts to consumers and produces statements of reasons.

visual_goal: Show one suspension fanning out from the enforcement service to five consumers, each returning a receipt, and the action counted in force only when all receipts are back.
prompt: A left-to-right fan-out diagram. At the far left, a small box 'Trust operations' with one arrow right into a central box 'Enforcement service' labeled 'suspend'. From 'Enforcement service' five solid blue arrows fan out to five boxes stacked vertically on the right: 'Catalog', 'Messaging', 'Ledger', 'Reservations', 'Other brand'. From each of the five boxes, including 'Ledger', a thin green dashed arrow returns to 'Enforcement service', each ending in a small green check-mark; three of these return arrows carry short labels: from 'Catalog' '26 listings hidden', from 'Messaging' '2 tokens revoked', from 'Reservations' '31 in review'. Finally one arrow from 'Enforcement service' back to 'Trust operations' labeled 'in force'. Important: there are exactly five green dashed return arrows, one from each of the five boxes, so 'Ledger' also has its own green dashed return arrow with a check-mark.
alt: Trust operations sends a suspension to the enforcement service, which fans it out to catalog, messaging, ledger, reservations and the other brand; each returns a receipt, and the action is reported in force.
